Your Partner in

GAME ART EXCELLENCE

Founded in 2004, Lakshya Digital is India’s largest art outsourcing studio. With a global team of over 1,000 talented professionals across multiple locations, we have proudly delivered more than 175 AAA titles and partnered with over 150 global developers to shape the visual identity of many iconic games.
